checks: Current baseline matches actual RowBank overwrite semantics: last depth block/last duplicate per move, then latest phase carrying that phase0 move at d9, with maximum over the original support. Consumed ambiguity flags exclude paired metrics.

Adaptive gate comparison matches production banked rank1 minus rank2, threshold10 and observed depth10; strict complete requested d9/d10/d12, unique rank/move rosters, legal support and recorded phase/gate checks exclude malformed and forced-stop rows rather than fallback.

Shared scalar cp_to_wdl uses declared slope0.006/draw width120, WDL side-to-move and float32. This is a diagnostic mapping before stored float16, not native UCI WDL or target-array equivalence. Mate-band pairs are excluded from CP means but retained in WDL statistics and explicit strata.
Best-set differences and disjointness are separated, avoiding arbitrary first-tied-move disagreement. Group sums retain source/config/shard/game identity, no position-independent CI is constructed.

Eligibility denominator is fixed result-and-phase0-valid528545; total physical531412 and all selected shard rows/hashes/stats must match. Declared 99.9% coverage and WDL-TV/large-Q-shift thresholds allocate investigation only, not playing strength.

Resource declaration matches command: one CPU process restricted to2cores, hidden GPU, numericthreads2,2GiBaddress-space,1770sTERM+30KILL; sampled512MiBoutputs and150GiBreserve checked each2048rows/per-shard. Exclusive execution directory prevents implicit retry. Completion still requires parent outer terminal status.

nonblocking_limits.detail: Production sets the next searchmoves to the leading8/4 moves from deepest_block_with_width of the previous phase. Census checks subset ancestry and width, but not exact equality/order to those previous top-k selections. Its descriptive current-versus-recorded-final comparison remains valid; do not claim full reconstruction/qualification of production roster selection from a passing row.

Malformed shapes/types or absent phase0d9 can raise rather than produce per-row flags because historical inspector and strict_block assume bank structure. A crash yields no COMPLETE receipt; this does not silently admit invalid rows. Scope is the already frozen structurally inspected bank.

The purposive64-shard bank, adaptive depth, restricted rosters and warm TT do not establish full-root d12 truth, calibration, current16.4M coverage, target quality or strength. Existing declarations correctly limit these claims.

operations: Read-only source/plan/fixture review. No running script edits, repeated source census, fixture reruns, model/GPU or payload scans.
